description: Consumo de energía eléctrica is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Gobierno de La Rioja. Through this statistic it is possible to know the consumption in Kilovatios hora, broken down by sectors of activity, as well as the evolution of said consumption. This information is prepared from the monthly data provided by IBERDROLA, S.A. on energy supplied. Coverage: Gobierno de La Rioja. The portal shows the English title as "Electric power consumption" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Gobierno de La Rioja. Its keywords include Consumo de energía eléctrica, La Rioja, Estadísticas, Sector de actividad económica. The listing shows 1 download or service links in HTML. The listing shows 2025-02-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
